candidates.storyHeadline: IRA Velinsky, industrial designer for Commodore and Atari
candidates.text: Why is the name 'Ira' capitalized in the title..?
I'm interested in 3D modelling, and I'm wondering if something like this would be adjacent enough to offer a new perspective but still be useful in art rather than just technical CAD?
I really do prefer using a programming language for describing 3D models. Like openscad. Yes, the openscad language is weird. Considering switching to python. Do you relate?
